notes.text: We've resolved an issue where the Editing Status column in a grid table overlapped with adjacent columns on larger screens
We've resolved an issue where SmartLink navigation landed on the wrong page when composite-entity key fields contained empty string values
List report pages and analytical list pages now apply default filter values defined using settings from Fiori launchpad when the app is loading
We've resolved an issue where custom filter values weren't restored when returning to a list report page after navigating away
The required field validation is no longer triggered incorrectly in an inline creation row when a user opens a value help or a date picker is opened from a field in that row

We've resolved an issue where clicking the Create button in a grid table in inline creation mode moved the focus to an existing row that included an error instead of moving it to the newly created empty row
We now ensure that the currency value and currency code fields in the visual filter bar are read correctly by the screen reader
We now ensure that the Editing Status column in grid and tree tables is read correctly by the screen reader
We've resolved an issue with duplicate cross-app navigation requests that were triggered by rapidly double-clicking an intent-based navigation link
The discard draft popup is no longer displayed when intent-based navigation links on the object page are opened in a new browser tab or window
We've resolved an issue where an error could occur in the smart table or smart chart if the user navigated away from a page before its state was saved
We've resolved an issue in the analytical table where clicking a SmartLink inside an expanded row didn't open the popover with navigation links
We now ensure that cross-app navigation remains available after the first time the target application opens in a new browser tab
We've resolved an issue in apps using the flexible column layout where row selections in a table on the object page weren't retained when a subobject page was opened in the third column
We've resolved an issue where navigating from a row in an Insights card generated from a list report opened an object page with no data
We've resolved an issue where internal navigation stopped working after refreshing the browser on a page opened through a deep link
We now ensure that the AI-assisted easy filter loads correctly for filter fields with a fixed value list that originate from a navigation property
We've resolved an issue where the link of an object page shared using the Send Email option in the Share menu couldn't be opened in certain email clients when the URL contained single quotes
We've improved accessibility for screen reader users by providing text on the analytical list page to inform them that a table is available as an alternative to the chart
We now ensure that primary actions such as Save in the footer remain visible on mobile devices when the draft status message is long
We've resolved an issue where a false warning about filters appeared on the list report page after reloading a saved view that included filters from a navigation property
